note: Test policies confirmed against each school's own admissions page, with the exact page line each rests on. The school's page decides; the Common App grid is only a fallback. Applied to colleges.json by scripts/apply-reviewed-test-policies.py and verified by scripts/check-reviewed-test-policies.mjs. `manual` means the page blocks automated requests and was read in a browser on the accessed date.

university-of-pennsylvania.label: Penn Admissions
evidence: Penn applicants are required to submit scores for the SAT or ACT. Applicants who face hardship in meeting this requirement can submit a waiver instead.

ohio-state-university.label: Ohio State admissions
evidence: Yes, standardized test scores from ACT or SAT are required for first-year applicants to the Columbus campus.
applicants who will have been out of high school for two or more years by their term of enrollment are not required to submit scores
ohio-state-university.note: Columbus campus. Applicants two or more years out of high school aren't required to submit scores. Regional campuses have their own application pages.

williams-college.label: Williams admission
evidence: Williams is truly test optional, so it's entirely up to you whether you submit exam results for the SAT or ACT.

university-of-san-diego.label: University of San Diego admission
evidence: As a “test-free ” campus, we pledge not to view an incoming student’s standardized tests during the admissions process.
university-of-san-diego.note: USD calls this "test-free": scores are not viewed.

university-of-kansas.label: University of Kansas admissions
evidence: The University of Kansas is test optional.
